QR codes for barakoCMS delivery: renders one field of a public entry as a PNG or SVG QR code, only for the fields a deployment lists per content type, so a claim token or a link can be scanned from a page, an email or a printed document.

Comments and notes for barakoCMS: a threaded comment on any record. A comment names its target by type and id, and it is only readable and postable by a caller who can read that record. Content entries work out of the box; any other module registers its own record type.
